exercises.name: Chair squat

Sturdy chair (no wheels): Bed edge (firm mattress, back against a wall)

instructions: Stand in front of the chair, feet shoulder-width apart.
Push hips back and lower slowly until you lightly touch the seat.
Drive through your heels to stand up tall.
safety_tips: Push the chair against a wall so it can't slide.
Keep knees tracking over your toes.
exercises.easier_variation: Sit fully on the chair between reps.
exercises.harder_variation: Wear a loaded backpack or pause 2 seconds above the seat.

exercises.name: Backpack-loaded push-up

Backpack (can be loaded with books): Two full water jugs strapped together

instructions: Wear the backpack snugly on your upper back.
Place hands slightly wider than shoulders, body in a straight line.
Lower your chest to just above the floor, then press back up.
safety_tips: Tighten the straps so the load doesn't shift.
Keep elbows about 45° from your body.
exercises.easier_variation: Remove the backpack, or put hands on a sturdy table edge.
exercises.harder_variation: Elevate your feet on a sturdy chair.

exercises.name: Table inverted row

Dining table: Heavy, low coffee table (test it holds your full weight first)
Two sturdy chairs with a broomstick laid across the seats

instructions: Lie on your back under the table with your chest below its edge.
Grip the edge shoulder-width apart, heels on the floor, body straight.
Pull your chest to the table, squeezing your shoulder blades, then lower slowly.
safety_tips: Only use a heavy, solid table — test it with your full weight first.
Never use a folding or glass table.
exercises.easier_variation: Bend your knees and keep feet flat.
exercises.harder_variation: Pause 2 seconds at the top of each rep.

exercises.name: Chair triceps dips
instructions: Sit on the edge of the chair, hands gripping the seat beside your hips.
Slide your hips forward off the seat, legs bent.
Lower until elbows reach about 90°, then press back up.
safety_tips: Brace the chair against a wall.
Stop above 90° if you feel shoulder discomfort.
exercises.easier_variation: Keep feet closer to the chair.
exercises.harder_variation: Straighten your legs or rest your heels on a second chair.

exercises.name: Couch Bulgarian split squat
instructions: Stand about two steps in front of the couch, facing away.
Rest the top of your back foot on the seat.
Lower your back knee toward the floor, then push through the front heel.
safety_tips: Make sure the couch won't slide backward.
Keep your front knee over your foot, not caving in.
exercises.easier_variation: Do a regular split squat with the back foot on the floor.
exercises.harder_variation: Hold a water jug in each hand.

exercises.name: Couch hip thrust

Couch / sofa: Sturdy chair (no wheels), seat facing you

instructions: Sit on the floor with your upper back against the couch edge.
Plant feet flat, knees bent about 90° at the top.
Drive hips up until your body is straight from knees to shoulders, squeeze, then lower.
safety_tips: Keep your chin tucked to avoid over-arching your lower back.
exercises.easier_variation: Glute bridge with shoulders on the floor.
exercises.harder_variation: Rest a loaded backpack on your hips, cushioned with a pillow.

exercises.name: Backpack Romanian deadlift
instructions: Hold the loaded backpack by its top handle or straps in front of your thighs.
With a slight knee bend, push hips back and lower the bag along your legs.
Stop when you feel a hamstring stretch, then drive hips forward to stand.
safety_tips: Keep your back flat — don't round to reach lower.
Check the handle can hold the load.
exercises.harder_variation: Single-leg version holding the bag in one hand.

exercises.name: Water jug overhead press

Water jugs / bottles: Backpack straps held in each hand

instructions: Hold a jug in each hand at shoulder height.
Brace your core and press both jugs overhead until arms are straight.
Lower slowly back to your shoulders.
safety_tips: Don't lean back — squeeze your glutes.
exercises.easier_variation: Press while seated on a sturdy chair, or use half-full jugs.
exercises.harder_variation: Press one arm at a time with a 3-second lowering.

exercises.name: Stair calf raise
instructions: Stand with the balls of your feet on the edge of a step.
Lower your heels below the step for a stretch.
Rise onto your toes as high as possible, then lower slowly.
safety_tips: Hold the railing or a wall for balance.

exercises.name: Wall sit

Wall: Heavy, flush furniture piece (e.g., a loaded bookshelf against a wall)

instructions: Lean your back flat against the wall.
Slide down until your knees are bent about 90°.
Hold the position, breathing steadily.
safety_tips: Keep knees over ankles, not past your toes.
Raise yourself higher if your knees hurt.
exercises.easier_variation: Hold at a shallower knee angle.
exercises.harder_variation: Hold a loaded backpack on your lap.
